content: Queue consensus: at-least-once is the norm; handlers must be idempotent such that a job killed at any point and re-run whole produces the same end state. 'One job, one responsibility' — chained side effects belong in separate jobs (Laravel Bus::chain, River). For multi-step work the standard pattern is: stage N performs its action AND enqueues stage N+1. Retries use exponential backoff with jitter, a max-attempt cap, and a dead-letter terminal state; a backoff schedule array beats a single flat delay. Cheap-idempotent steps need only an idempotency key + dedup index; steps with external side effects need transactional enqueue (outbox) so the chain link cannot be lost.
